let window = 1h;
let fails = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(window)
    | where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet" and DeviceProduct has "Fortigate"
    | where DeviceAction =~ "ssl-login-fail" or Message has "ssl-login-fail" or DeviceEventClassID == "0101039426"
    | summarize Fails = count(), FailUsers = make_set(SourceUserName, 50) by SourceIP
    | where Fails > 20;   // 20 = burst floor distinguishing stuffing from a typo
let success = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(window)
    | where DeviceVendor =~ "Fortinet" and DeviceProduct has "Fortigate"
    | where DeviceAction in~ ("ssl-login","tunnel-up") or Message has_any ("SSL VPN login successfully","tunnel-up")
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SourceIP, SuccessUser = SourceUserName, DestinationIP;
success
| join kind=inner fails on SourceIP
| project SuccessTime, SourceIP, SuccessUser, DestinationIP, Fails, FailUsers
| order by SuccessTime desc

description: Detects a Node/Bun/shell process in an AUR build lineage creating a systemd service or timer unit, consistent with Atomic Arch persistence (the campaign also deploys an eBPF rootkit when run as root).
references:
    - https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-aur-supply-chain-ebpf-rootkit-20260614-csa/
    - https://corgea.com/research/atomic-arch-aur-atomic-lockfile-js-digest-ebpf-rootkit
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
    - attack.t1543.002
    - attack.t1014
    - attack.t1547.006
logsource:
    category: file_event
    product: linux
detection:
    selection_path:
        TargetFilename|contains:
            - '/etc/systemd/system/'
            - '/usr/lib/systemd/system/'
            - '/.config/systemd/user/'
    selection_ext:
        TargetFilename|endswith:
            - '.service'
            - '.timer'
    selection_proc:
        Image|endswith:
            - '/node'
            - '/bun'
            - '/npm'
            - '/npx'
            - '/makepkg'
    condition: selection_path and selection_ext and selection_proc
falsepositives:
    - A legitimate AUR package whose install hook installs a systemd unit via a packaged install script
level: high
2610.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.process_name IN ("node","bun","npm","npx","makepkg","bash","sh","python3")) AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/etc/systemd/system/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/lib/systemd/system/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.config/systemd/user/*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.service" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.timer") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2610.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| regex("/etc/systemd/system/|/usr/lib/systemd/system/|/.config/systemd/user/", field=TargetFileName)
| regex("(service|timer)$", field=TargetFileName)
| regex("/(node|bun|npm|npx|makepkg|bash|sh)$", field=ContextImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2666.sent:
let win = 5m;
let mgmt = dynamic(["/key/","/user/","/team/","/model/","/customer/","/spend/","/organization/"]);
let fails = ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Url has_any (mgmt)
| where toint(HttpStatusCode) in (401, 403)
| project FailTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, FailUrl = Url, FailHost = tostring(HttpHostName);
let success = ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Url has_any (mgmt)
| where toint(HttpStatusCode) in (200, 201, 204)
| project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, SuccessUrl = Url, SuccessHost = tostring(HttpHostName), HttpMethod, HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent;
fails
| join kind=inner success on SrcIpAddr
| where SuccessTime between (FailTime .. FailTime + win)
| extend HostChanged = FailHost != SuccessHost
| project FailTime, SuccessTime, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', SuccessTime, FailTime), SrcIpAddr, FailUrl, SuccessUrl, FailHost, SuccessHost, HostChanged, HttpMethod, HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent
| order by SuccessTime desc
2666.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*/key/*" OR Web.url="*/user/*" OR Web.url="*/team/*" OR Web.url="*/model/*" OR Web.url="*/customer/*" OR Web.url="*/spend/*" OR Web.url="*/organization/*") (Web.status=401 OR Web.status=403 OR Web.status=200 OR Web.status=201 OR Web.status=204) by _time span=1s Web.src Web.url Web.status Web.url_domain
| `drop_dm_object_name("Web")`
| eval phase=if(status IN("401","403"),"fail",if(status IN("200","201","204"),"success",null()))
| where isnotnull(phase)
| sort 0 src _time
| streamstats time_window=5m current=t last(eval(if(phase="fail",_time,null()))) as lastFail last(eval(if(phase="fail",url_domain,null()))) as failHost by src
| where phase="success" AND isnotnull(lastFail)
| eval delaySec = _time - lastFail
| where delaySec >= 0 AND delaySec <= 300
| eval hostChanged = if(url_domain!=failHost,"true","false")
| table _time src url status url_domain failHost hostChanged delaySec
| sort - _time

description: Detects CVE-2026-48746 / CVE-2026-48710 exploitation where the HTTP Host header on a vLLM /v1 request contains URL-structural characters (/, ?, #) used to poison Starlette's reconstructed url.path and bypass AuthenticationMiddleware.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-94f4-hr76-p5j6
  - https://ostif.org/disclosing-the-badhost-vulnerability-in-starlette/
  - https://badhost.org/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '/v1/'
  hostinjection:
    cs-host|re: '[/?#]'
  condition: selection and hostinjection
falsepositives:
  - Authorized web-app pentest / scanner traffic (Burp, Nuclei)
  - Misconfigured client placing a full URL in the Host header
level: high
2699.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.status) as status values(Web.http_method) as http_method values(Web.url) as url from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/v1/*" by Web.site Web.src Web.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| regex site="[/?#]"
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime

2700.sent:
let lookback = 7d;
let failures = ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
  | where Url has "/v1/"
  | where HttpStatusCode in ("401","403")
  | summarize FailCount=count(), FirstFail=min(TimeGenerated) by SrcIpAddr, HttpHostName;
let successes = ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
  | where Url has "/v1/"
  | where HttpStatusCode in ("200","201")
  | where isempty(HttpRequestHeaderAuthorization)        // succeeded with no key => bypass
  | summarize SuccessCount=count(), FirstSuccess=min(TimeGenerated), LastSuccess=max(TimeGenerated) by SrcIpAddr, HttpHostName;
failures
| join kind=inner successes on SrcIpAddr
| where FirstSuccess > FirstFail                          // probe THEN succeed
| where FailCount >= 3                                    // >=3 = deliberate probing, not a single typo
| project SrcIpAddr, ProbedHost=HttpHostName, FailCount, FirstFail, SuccessCount, FirstSuccess, LastSuccess
| order by FirstSuccess desc
2700.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/v1/*" (Web.status=401 OR Web.status=403 OR Web.status=200 OR Web.status=201) by Web.src Web.site Web.status
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| stats min(eval(if(status IN("401","403"),firstTime,null()))) as firstFail max(eval(if(status IN("200","201"),firstTime,null()))) as lastSuccess sum(eval(if(status IN("401","403"),count,0))) as failCount sum(eval(if(status IN("200","201"),count,0))) as successCount by src site
| where isnotnull(firstFail) AND isnotnull(lastSuccess) AND lastSuccess>firstFail AND failCount>=3 AND successCount>0
| convert ctime(firstFail) ctime(lastSuccess)
| sort - lastSuccess
